### ContentEntry

Interface. `import type { ContentEntry } from "@nowaki-dev/runtime/content";`

```ts
export interface ContentEntry<D = unknown> {
    collection: string;
    slug: string;
    locale?: string;
    file: string;
    data: D;
    body?: string;
    html?: string;
    headings?: ContentHeading[];
    render?: () => Promise<{
        Content: (props?: Record<string, unknown>) => unknown;
        headings: ContentHeading[];
    }>;
}
```

One entry of a collection, as `getCollection` / `getEntry` return it.

Members:

- `collection`: The collection's name.
- `slug`: The path under the collection without its extension: `posts/hello`. With i18n, without the
  locale directory.
- `locale`: With `i18n` in nowaki.config: the locale of the collection's first-level directory the entry
  is in (`content/blog/ja/hello.md` → `"ja"`). Undefined for an entry outside a locale directory,
  which belongs to every locale.
- `file`: The source file, relative to the app root.
- `data`: The validated frontmatter or data.
- `body`: Markdown entries: the source after the frontmatter.
- `html`: Markdown entries: the rendered HTML, its headings with anchor ids.
- `headings`: Markdown entries: the headings of `html`.
- `render`: MDX entries (`.mdx`): the compiled module's component and headings. Render `<Content />`
  where Markdown entries put `html`; components and islands it imports work as in TSX.

Uses: [`ContentHeading`](#contentheading).

Used by: [`CollectionQuery`](#collectionquery), [`getCollection`](#getcollection), [`getEntry`](#getentry).

### Collections

Interface. `import type { Collections } from "@nowaki-dev/runtime/content";`

```ts
export interface Collections {}
```

Collections by name. `nowaki typegen` fills this in from content/config.ts, so getCollection
and getEntry are typed per collection. Without it, entries are `ContentEntry<unknown>`.

Used by: [`DataOf`](#dataof).

### defineCollection

Function. `import { defineCollection } from "@nowaki-dev/runtime/content";`

```ts
export declare function defineCollection<S extends StandardSchemaV1>(def: CollectionDefinition<S>): CollectionDefinition<S>;
```

Declares a collection in content/config.ts. `schema` (any Standard Schema library) validates
the frontmatter or the data file; `nowaki build` fails on an invalid entry.

Example:

```tsx
export const blog = defineCollection({ schema: z.object({ title: z.string() }) });
```

Uses: [`StandardSchemaV1`](runtime.md#standardschemav1), [`CollectionDefinition`](#collectiondefinition).

### CollectionQuery

Interface. `import type { CollectionQuery } from "@nowaki-dev/runtime/content";`

```ts
export interface CollectionQuery<D> {
    locale?: string;
    filter?: (entry: ContentEntry<D>) => boolean;
}
```

The options object of `getCollection`.

Members:

- `locale`: i18n: the entries of this locale (and those outside any locale directory), or `"*"` for every
  entry. Defaults to the current request's locale (`getLocale()`); without i18n, every entry.
- `filter`: Keeps the entries it returns true for.

Uses: [`ContentEntry`](#contententry).

Used by: [`getCollection`](#getcollection).

### getCollection

Function. `import { getCollection } from "@nowaki-dev/runtime/content";`

```ts
export declare function getCollection<K extends string>(name: K, filter?: ((entry: ContentEntry<DataOf<K>>) => boolean) | CollectionQuery<DataOf<K>>): Promise<ContentEntry<DataOf<K>>[]>;
```

Every entry of a collection, sorted by slug; `filter` (a function, or `{ filter }`) keeps the
ones it returns true for. With i18n, only the current locale's entries and the locale-less
ones, unless `{ locale }` says otherwise. Throws for an unknown collection.

Uses: [`ContentEntry`](#contententry), [`DataOf`](#dataof), [`CollectionQuery`](#collectionquery).


One entry by slug, or undefined. With i18n, the current locale's (or `{ locale }`'s), falling
back to the entry outside any locale directory.

Uses: [`ContentEntry`](#contententry), [`DataOf`](#dataof).
